function saveData(key, value) {

function getYesterdayStr() {

  var day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return y + '-' + m + '-' + day;
}

function formatDate(dateStr) {
  if (!dateStr) return '';

// ======== 分配每日单词 ========
function assignDailyWords() {
  var progress = loadData(KEYS.progress, {});
  var today = getTodayStr();

  if (progress[today] && progress[today].assigned) {
    todayWordsData = progress[today].assigned.map(function(id) {
      return WORD_BANK.find(function(w) { return w.id === id; });
    }).filter(Boolean);
    return;
  }

  // 轮换分配：根据已有天数决定偏移量
  var dayCount = Object.keys(progress).length;
  var offset = (dayCount * 5) % WORD_BANK.length;
  var assigned = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    assigned.push(WORD_BANK[(offset + i) % WORD_BANK.length].id);
  }

  progress[today] = {
    assigned: assigned,
    learned: [],
    practiceScore: 0,
    practiceDone: false,
    pointsEarned: 0
  };
  saveData(KEYS.progress, progress);

  todayWordsData = assigned.map(function(id) {
    return WORD_BANK.find(function(w) { return w.id === id; });
  }).filter(Boolean);
}

// ======== 检查逾期 ========
function checkOverdue() {
  var progress = loadData(KEYS.progress, {});
  var today = getTodayStr();
  var yesterday = getYesterdayStr();

  overdueWords = [];

  // 检查昨天未学完的单词
  if (progress[yesterday]) {
    var yAssigned = progress[yesterday].assigned || [];
    var yLearned = progress[yesterday].learned || [];
    var unlearned = yAssigned.filter(function(id) { return yLearned.indexOf(id) === -1; });

    unlearned.forEach(function(id) {
      var w = WORD_BANK.find(function(w) { return w.id === id; });
      if (w) overdueWords.push(w);
    });

    // 把昨天没学完的单词顺延到今天
    if (unlearned.length > 0 && progress[today]) {
      var todayAssigned = progress[today].assigned || [];
      // 把逾期的单词加到今天的列表前面
      unlearned.forEach(function(id) {
        if (todayAssigned.indexOf(id) === -1) {
          todayAssigned.unshift(id);
        }
      });
      // 确保今天最多有足够的单词（可能超过5个，因为有顺延的）
      progress[today].assigned = todayAssigned;
      saveData(KEYS.progress, progress);

      // 更新今天单词数据
      todayWordsData = todayAssigned.map(function(id) {
        return WORD_BANK.find(function(w) { return w.id === id; });
      }).filter(Boolean);
    }

    // 昨天的练习没做也算逾期

    }
  }
}

function startPractice() {
  // 生成题目
  var questions = [];
  todayWordsData.forEach(function(w) {
    // 题型1：填空题
    var blanked = w.sentence.replace(new RegExp(w.word, 'i'), '___');
    var options = [w.word];
    // 随机选3个干扰项
    var pool = WORD_BANK.filter(function(x) { return x.id !== w.id; });
    pool = shuffleArray(pool).slice(0, 3);
    pool.forEach(function(p) { options.push(p.word); });
    options = shuffleArray(options);
    var correctIdx = options.indexOf(w.word);

    questions.push({
      question: blanked,
      hint: '选择正确的单词填空',
      options: options,
      correctIdx: correctIdx,
      selectedIdx: -1,
      answered: false
    });
  });

  practiceState = { active: true, current: 0, questions: questions, score: 0, correct: 0 };
  renderTab();
}

function shuffleArray(arr) {
  var a = arr.slice();
  for (var i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    var j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    var tmp = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = tmp;
  }
  return a;
}

function answerPractice(idx) {
  var q = practiceState.questions[practiceState.current];
  if (q.answered) return;
  q.answered = true;
  q.selectedIdx = idx;
  if (idx === q.correctIdx) {
    practiceState.correct++;
    practiceState.score += 20;
    speak(q.options[idx]);
    showToast('回答正确！', 'success');
  } else {
    showToast('正确答案是：' + q.options[q.correctIdx], 'error');
  }
  renderTab();
}

function nextQuestion() {
  if (practiceState.current < practiceState.questions.length - 1) {
    practiceState.current++;
    renderTab();

}

function getLevel(totalPoints) {
  for (var i = LEVELS.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (totalPoints >= LEVELS[i].min) return LEVELS[i];
  }
  return LEVELS[0];
}

function addPoints(amount, action) {
  var points = loadData(KEYS.points, { total: 0, history: [], rewards: DEFAULT_REWARDS.slice() });
  points.total += amount;
  if (!points.history) points.history = [];
  points.history.push({ date: getTodayStr(), action: action, points: amount });
  saveData(KEYS.points, points);
}

function claimReward(rewardId) {
  var points = loadData(KEYS.points, { total: 0, history: [], rewards: [] });
  var reward = (points.rewards || []).find(function(r) { return r.id === rewardId; });
  if (!reward) return;
  if (reward.claimed) { showToast('已经兑换过了', 'warn'); return; }
  if (points.total < reward.cost) { showToast('积分不够哦', 'error'); return; }

  showConfirm('兑换奖励', '确定要用 ' + reward.cost + ' 积分兑换「' + reward.name + '」吗？', function() {
    points.total -= reward.cost;
    reward.claimed = true;
    saveData(KEYS.points, points);
    showToast('兑换成功！请找家长领取奖励', 'success');
    triggerConfetti();
    renderTab();
    renderTodaySection();

}

function updateRecords(practiceScore) {
  var today = getTodayStr();
  var progress = loadData(KEYS.progress, {});

  var records = loadData(KEYS.records, []);

  // 更新或添加今天的记录
  var existing = records.find(function(r) { return r.date === today; });
  var learnedCount = todayProg.learned ? todayProg.learned.length : 0;
  var pointsEarned = todayProg.pointsEarned || 0;

  // 获取当前总积分
  var points = loadData(KEYS.points, { total: 0 });

  if (existing) {
    existing.wordsLearned = learnedCount;
    existing.practiceScore = practiceScore;
    existing.pointsEarned = pointsEarned;
    existing.totalPoints = points.total;
  } else {
    records.push({
      date: today,
      wordsLearned: learnedCount,
      practiceScore: practiceScore,
      pointsEarned: pointsEarned,
      totalPoints: points.total

function addReward() {
  var nameInput = document.getElementById('reward-name');
  var costInput = document.getElementById('reward-cost');
  var name = nameInput.value.trim();
  var cost = parseInt(costInput.value);
  if (!name) { showToast('请输入奖励名称', 'warn'); return; }
  if (!cost || cost < 1) { showToast('请输入有效积分', 'warn'); return; }

  var points = loadData(KEYS.points, { total: 0, history: [], rewards: [] });
  if (!points.rewards) points.rewards = [];
  var maxId = 0;
  points.rewards.forEach(function(r) { if (r.id > maxId) maxId = r.id; });
  points.rewards.push({ id: maxId + 1, name: name, cost: cost, claimed: false });
  saveData(KEYS.points, points);
  nameInput.value = '';
  costInput.value = '';
  showToast('奖励添加成功', 'success');
  renderParentDashboard();
}

function deleteReward(id) {
  showConfirm('删除奖励', '确定要删除这个奖励吗？', function() {
    var points = loadData(KEYS.points, { total: 0, history: [], rewards: [] });
    points.rewards = (points.rewards || []).filter(function(r) { return r.id !== id; });

    showToast('已删除', 'success');
    renderParentDashboard();
  });
}

function resetReward(id) {
  showConfirm('重置奖励', '确定要重置为未兑换状态吗？', function() {
    var points = loadData(KEYS.points, { total: 0, history: [], rewards: [] });
    var r = (points.rewards || []).find(function(r) { return r.id === id; });
    if (r) {
      r.claimed = false;
      saveData(KEYS.points, points);
      showToast('已重置', 'success');

}

// ======== 数据备份 ========
function exportData() {
  var data = {
    settings: loadData(KEYS.settings, {}),
    words: loadData(KEYS.words, WORD_BANK),
    progress: loadData(KEYS.progress, {}),
    points: loadData(KEYS.points, {}),
    records: loadData(KEYS.records, []),
    exportDate: getTodayStr(),
    version: '1.0'
  };
  var json = JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
  var blob = new Blob([json], { type: 'application/json' });
  var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = '英语启蒙台_备份_' + getTodayStr() + '.json';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  showToast('备份已导出', 'success');
}

function importData(event) {
  var file = event.target.files[0];
  if (!file) return;
  var reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = function(e) {
    try {
      var data = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
      if (data.settings) saveData(KEYS.settings, data.settings);
      if (data.words) saveData(KEYS.words, data.words);
      if (data.progress) saveData(KEYS.progress, data.progress);
      if (data.points) saveData(KEYS.points, data.points);
      if (data.records) saveData(KEYS.records, data.records);
      showToast('数据导入成功！', 'success');
      // 重新初始化
      assignDailyWords();
      checkOverdue();
      renderTodaySection();
      if (currentMode === 'child') {
        renderTab();
      } else {
        renderParentDashboard();
      }
    } catch(err) {
      showToast('导入失败，文件格式不正确', 'error');
    }
  };
  reader.readAsText(file);
  event.target.value = '';
}

// ======== 语音朗读 ========
function speak(text) {
  if (!window.speechSynthesis) {
    showToast('浏览器不支持语音播放', 'warn');
    return;
  }
  window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
  var utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  utterance.lang = 'en-US';
  utterance.rate = 0.8;
  utterance.pitch = 1.2;
  window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
}

// ======== Toast 通知 ========
function showToast(msg, type) {
  var toast = document.getElementById('toast');
  toast.textContent = msg;
  toast.className = 'toast show ' + (type || '');
  setTimeout(function() {
    toast.classList.remove('show');

}

  document.getElementById('confirm-modal').classList.add('show');

}
function closeConfirm() {
  document.getElementById('confirm-modal').classList.remove('show');
  confirmCallback = null;
}
document.getElementById('confirm-ok-btn').onclick = function() {

};

// ======== 庆祝彩带 ========

  var container = document.getElementById('confetti');

    container.innerHTML = '';
  }, 4500);
}

// ======== 启动 ========
init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

搞定啦！英语启蒙工作台已经打开预览了，可以直接在右边看到效果。下面给你说说这个工作台有什么：

---

### 四大模块

**1. 每日单词** — 每天5个词轮换学习
- 30个适合8岁孩子的英语单词（动物/食物/动作/自然/形容词/颜色/学习）
- 带音标、中文释义、例句（中英对照）
- 每个词有「听发音」按钮（浏览器语音朗读，不需要联网）
- 进度环显示今日学习进度，学完一个得1分，全学完额外+10分

**2. 音标卡片** — 3D翻转卡片
- 正面显示英文单词+音标，点击翻转到背面看释义和例句
- 左右切换卡片，带发音按钮
- 复习完成得5分

**3. 组词练习** — 填空选择题
- 用今天的单词造句，挖空让宝贝选正确答案
- 5道题，每题4个选项，选错会告诉正确答案
- 80分以上3星+10分，60分以上2星+5分，做了就有分

**4. 积分闯关** — 5级等级 + 奖励商城
- 5个等级：英语小萌新 → 单词学徒 → 词汇达人 → 英语小达人 → 英语之星
- 积分商城：宝贝用积分兑换家长设置的奖励（看动画片、吃零食、去公园等）
- 兑换时弹确认提示，扣积分后由家长线下兑现

### 家长/孩子双模式

- **孩子模式**：看单词、翻卡片、做练习、攒积分、兑换奖励
- **家长模式**：4位密码进入 → 看学习概览、管理奖励、查学习记录、导出/导入/清空数据

### 置顶「今天要处理」
- 昨天没学完的单词自动顺延到今天，红色标注「逾期」+「补学」标签
- 昨天的练习没做也会提醒

### 数据安全
- 所有数据存在浏览器本地，刷新关掉不丢
- 首屏有「导出备份」「导入恢复」按钮
- 家长模式里也有完整的数据管理
